title: Laramie's Dorrell throws no-hitter at Douglas | WyoSports | wyomingnews.com
text:
Maddox Dorrell will remember this one.
Dorrell tossed a 12-strikeout no-hitter as the Laramie Rangers routed the Douglas Cats, 11-0 (five innings), in game one of a Wednesday night doubleheader in Douglas. Laramie also won, 8-0, in game two.
Dorrell also did not allow a walk.
Game one
Laramie erupted for six runs in the second inning, then tacked on three runs in the fourth for a 9-0 lead.
Laramie also outhit Douglas, 8-0, and all but two Rangers recorded a hit.
Jaxon Gosar led with two hits and two RBI at the No. 9 spot.
Jax McLean, Cayden Hardesty, TR Richardson, Trace Looney, Will Harris and Larsen Wesnitzer each logged a hit.
Game two
Wesnitzer pitched a three-hit complete game while his offense supported.
Wesnitzer struck out six and walked four.
Laramie built upon a 1-0 lead, thanks to three runs in the third inning. The Rangers led 7-0 after five innings.
Quade Gill made it 8-0 in the seventh inning when he scored on a Hardesty walk.
Looney and Gosar led with two hits apiece. Hardesty, Richardson, Harris and Dorrell each added a hit.
Laramie (16-19) will visit Mountain View at 5 p.m. Thursday in Loveland, Colorado.
